records.robustness_evidence: The original 567-day signal weakens with correlated/chromatic noise and fails conditional time, receiver-band and source consistency checks. The separate 67-day feature is not this candidate.
records.confirmation_evidence: Overlapping PPTA observations do not corroborate a common planetary timing delay. Source errors and shared propagation limit the comparison.
